title: Midnight Tofu Panna Cotta
description: A creamy Italian dessert featuring midnight tofu, nutty flavors, and a delicate texture.
instructions: Combine midnight tofu, nutty, silken tofu, maple syrup, vanilla extract (if using), and lemon zest in a blender.
Pour the mixture into small individual serving cups or ramekins.
Place the cups in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the cups.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25-30 minutes or until set.
Remove the cups from the water bath and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional nutty or fresh fruit if desired.
